commit.message:
Merge origin/main (fees + recurring landed) into dunning D1

Conflict resolutions (B-DUNR-119, agent 119):
- stripe-connect-api.service.ts: main's interfaces (StripeSubscriptionCheckoutObject,
  StripeSetupIntentObject, StripeBalanceTransactionObject, StripeChargeObject,
  STRIPE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS) kept, D1's StripeInvoiceObject added after them;
  createSubscription returns main's StripeSubscriptionCheckoutObject; checkout
  session payment/subscription branches take main's on_behalf_of form (S-FEE
  removed destination charges); listBalanceTransactions + listChargeRefunds from
  main. Duplicate methods: main's createSetupIntent, retrieveSetupIntent,
  setSubscriptionDefaultPaymentMethod and voidInvoice kept (D1 copies had no
  caller in D1-D2c); retrieveInvoice keeps main's position and gains D1's
  payment_intent expand and StripeInvoiceObject type.
- email.types.ts / email.service.ts: main's COACH_PAYOUT_ADJUSTMENT entry kept in
  place, D1's DUNNING_V2_CLIENT / DUNNING_V2_COACH appended after it.
